Bird Dynamic low resolution marine bird counts

bdydata_colonies_counts_low_res.Rd

This table gives accurate counts of breeding pairs (Apparently Occupied Sites) of marine birds along the french coastline, between 2009 and 2021, based on data aggregated by the french Groupement d'Intéret Scientifique Oiseaux Marins (GISOM). It is the primary data source used by the model to compute projections of future population dynamics.

CAUTION Because of the sensitive nature of these data, colonies have been clustered to lower the spatial resolution, thus each line of the table represents a group of colonies (within 5km of each other + isolated colonies within 20km), with the centroid given as coordinates. This may slightly alter the results of the population models. If you need to use the unaltered dataset, you can either use your own dataset, contact the GISOM, of use the dedicated online application at https://shiny.cefe.cnrs.fr/Shiny_Bird_dynamic.

Usage

bdydata_colonies_counts_low_res

Format

Dataframe (.rda)

Details

Includes the following columns:

  • colony: unique identifier for the group of colonies

  • lon: longitude of the group centroid

  • lat: latitude of the group centroid

  • seafront: on which seafront is the group located (either "atlantic" or "mediterranean)

  • species_latin: latin name of the species

  • species_fr: french vernacular name of the species (optional)

  • species_en: english vernacular name of the species (optional)

  • year: year at which the count was made

  • count: number of breeding couples recorded for the given colony group, species, and year
